title: An Astronaut's Helmet Filled With Water During a Spacewalk

scenes.text: An astronaut nearly drowned in space.
In July 2013, Luca Parmitano was on a spacewalk outside the space station.
About half an hour in, he felt cold water on the back of his head.
It spread over his eyes and nose, and he could barely see or hear.
In space water doesn't fall. It sticks to your face, and you can't cough it out.
He found his way back to the airlock mostly from memory. About a liter and a half of water was in his helmet.

description:
An astronaut nearly drowned in space.
In July 2013, Luca Parmitano's helmet filled with about a liter and a half of water during a spacewalk. NASA ended it after 1 hour 32 minutes, instead of the planned six and a half hours.
Could you stay calm in his place?
